relations_single_target.name: relations_single_target
relations_single_target.value:
(CASE WHEN "relations"."to_object_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN "relations"."to_message_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN "relations"."to_url" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN "relations"."to_file_key" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1

proposals_proposer_identified.name: proposals_proposer_identified
proposals_proposer_identified.value:
("proposals"."proposer_kind" = 'model' AND "proposals"."proposer_model" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("proposals"."proposer_kind" = 'human' AND "proposals"."proposer_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
